semantics.PF: MW entering the asset at the literal from terminal
semantics.PT: MW entering the asset at the literal to terminal
semantics.source_table_port_expression: Local convention: positive flow from the first named terminal to the second, measured at the starred end. This is not a certified P32 gate coefficient or expression.
semantics.AC_losses: A receiving-end -PT differs from sending-end PF by active losses; never replace one with the other in an AC comparison.
semantics.DC_only: PF = -PT only in a verified lossless representation. That identity does not establish circuit membership.
semantics.source_dates: Publication/study edition only. No automatic timestamp-based operational selection.
